prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A flat app-icon glyph — a single horizontal line broken in the middle
by an upward-arrow notch, symbolizing crossing a threshold. Ember-
orange flat fill, urgent.
formatted_prompt: Flat modern app icon, centered on off-white (#E7E3D5) canvas with generous padding. A single bold horizontal line in ember-orange (#D97742) broken at its midpoint by a sharp upward-pointing chevron notch — the line rises to a crisp arrowhead peak then descends, forming a threshold-crossing glyph. The entire mark is one unified flat vector shape, solid ember-orange fill, sharp crisp edges, no gradients, no texture, no detail strokes. Silhouette reads instantly at 16px. Deep near-black (#0B0F14) background alternative version implied by high contrast. Urgent, minimal, geometric — single-color glyph icon in the register of Phosphor Fill or Material Symbols Filled.
